verdictWhy: I built the whole evening in an afternoon without asking anyone, and the top of the screen always told me what GO would do next, including 'then, when it ends: 6 · Lantern'. What holds me back is Show mode: I could pull the Master fader to silence with a small slip, and then the app refused to let me put it back until I left Show mode. I'd tour with it, but I'd be nervous with my hand near that fader.

tasks.notes: Start from a folder, then 'Make cues from these 7 sounds' in the side drawer, then Accept. The cues came out numbered 1 to 7 and named from the files with the numbers stripped. I didn't expect the step through the assistant drawer.

Time & Loops ▸ Whole sound switch turned the loop on. A Fade cue added under House music already targeted it, went to -inf and had 'Stop target when done' on, so I only typed 8. hear confirmed it was still looping after 43 s and was silent after the fade.
Start · End 0:12 to 0:40 on Time & Loops, Fade out 5 on the Audio tab. In Show mode it started at 0:12, the fade began at 0:35 and it was silent at 0:40.
Driftwood set to auto-follow and Lantern given a 3 s Pre-wait (Post-wait's help says it only works with auto-continue). In the run Lantern waited 3 s and then started on its own.
Audio tab ▸ Level -4. hear said 'Salt at -4.0 dB'. My first try went wrong: my click missed the field, so Cmd+A selected all 8 cues. Nothing changed.
Save worked straight away and everything was there after reopening. But the show had been saved inside the music folder, called 'tour music', and I never chose where it went or what it was called.
Tools ▸ Load to Time (Cmd+T): 0:30, Load, GO. The screen said 'LOADED TO 0:30.0 · this GO only'. Esc stopped it, and the second time the field still had 0:30 in it.

The Show button locked editing and the whole evening ran right. Clicking a waveform and then Skip moved me through each track. But the Master fader still moves in Show mode and its reset button is refused there.
Help ▸ Keyboard Shortcuts: GO is Space, Panic is Esc (press again to stop dead), and Playhead up ↑ or 'Previous cue that needs a GO' is '-'.

findings.title: In Show mode the Master fader can be dragged to silence, but its reset button is refused
findings.expected: When the footer says 'SHOW MODE — editing is locked', I expect a stray drag not to change the show's levels. If the fader is meant to stay live, I expect its own reset button to work too.
findings.happened: With Bows playing, an 84 px drag on the Master fader took it to '−∞' and a 34 px drag took it to '−20'. The Save button changed to 'Save · 1', so this was a change to the show. Clicking '↺' ('Put back to 0') only brought up a toast, 'Show mode: editing is locked', and the fader stayed at −20. I had to switch to Edit to reset it.
findings.steps: Open any show with sounds, click Show, GO a sound, drag the Master fader at the bottom right to the left a little, then click ↺ next to 'Master'.
findings.suggestion: Either lock the mixer in Show mode the same way the cue list is locked, or let ↺ work there.

findings.title: Start from a folder puts the show inside the music folder, named after it, without asking
findings.expected: To pick a name and a place the first time I save, as QLab does.
findings.happened: After 'Start from a folder…' the title read 'tour music' and Save showed 'Saved' right away. show.json and a logs folder were added among the WAVs. Save never asked where or under what name.
findings.steps: Welcome screen ▸ Start from a folder… ▸ choose a folder of sounds and look at the title and the Save button.

findings.title: Start from a folder makes no cues; they are offered in the Assistant drawer
findings.expected: The button's hint says 'A folder of sounds becomes the show', so I expected seven cues to appear.
findings.happened: The list said 'No cues yet / Drop sound files here.' Over on the right the Assistant drawer said '7 sounds not in a cue yet.' with 'Make cues from these 7 sounds', followed by a proposed change I had to Accept. It worked, but 'Assistant' made me wonder if I was using a paid AI feature.
findings.steps: Welcome ▸ Start from a folder… ▸ choose a folder.

findings.title: The inspector is a short strip, so most fields need scrolling
findings.expected: To see a cue's settings without scrolling, since most of the window above was an empty cue list.
findings.happened: On Time & Loops the waveform fills the strip and the loop switch is below it, out of sight. On Audio I had to scroll to reach Level. Opening '▸ More' rearranged the Basics fields, so Pre-wait was in a different place on the next cue I selected.
findings.steps: Select an Audio cue ▸ Time & Loops: the 'Whole sound' loop switch only shows after you scroll the inspector.

findings.title: Music files go on a bus called 'Effects' by default
findings.expected: Music tracks on the Music bus, or no bus I need to think about.
findings.happened: Each of the seven cues' Audio tab showed 'Bus: Effects'.
findings.steps: Start from a folder of music ▸ make cues ▸ Audio tab ▸ Bus.

findings.title: Show mode leaves Edit one click away with no confirmation, and Reset is hidden
findings.expected: Leaving Show mode during a running show to be slightly harder than one click. 'Back to the top' to still be available.
findings.happened: Clicking 'Edit' while Bows was playing unlocked straight away. The 'Reset' button ('Stop all, back to the top') is not shown in Show mode, so I clicked row 1 to go back to the top.
findings.steps: Click Show, GO a cue, click Edit.

findings.title: Load to Time is clear and remembers the time
findings.expected: To have to type 0:30 again every time.
findings.happened: The screen showed 'LOADED TO 0:30.0 · this GO only' over the GO button, and Cmd+T came back with 0:30 already filled in.

findings.title: The 'Standing by' line says what GO will do, including auto-follow
findings.expected: To work out the follow from the small icons.
findings.happened: With Driftwood standing by it said 'then, when it ends: 6 · Lantern'. Every other cue showed 'then N · name'.

findings.title: A Fade cue added under a sound is already set up as a fade-out and stop
findings.expected: To set the target, the level and the stop by hand, as in QLab.
findings.happened: It was numbered 1.5, targeted '1 · House music', went to -inf and had 'Stop target when done' on.

findings.title: Skipping ahead in Show mode needs a deliberate second click
findings.expected: To be afraid that clicking a waveform would jump the music.
findings.happened: Clicking the waveform only set a mark ('◆ 0:48.3') and offered 'Skip', 'Fade to' and 'Clear'. Nothing moved until I clicked Skip.

rig: The app menu's Quit is not available in a test session, so I closed it with the rig's stop and started it again.
hear reports a cue's own level and ignores the Master fader: with Master at −∞ it still said 'Bows at 0.0 dB'. I could not confirm the silence with my ears.
During a fade, hear shows the starting level ('at 0.0 dB (fading to -60 dB)') and calls the fade cue 'waiting'.
Windows, the reason Dana came, could not be tried: the session runs on a Mac.
